The Dai Trung Gate is a three-bay gate, resting solidly on a brick foundation, its unique design featuring an embossed hồ lô vase rising serenely from the roof's peak. This tranquil scene is nestled peacefully amidst the green lawn and ancient trees, which cast their shade on both sides of the bright red brick path.
